content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager — P1: Elevated error rate and 500s from tenant 'Titan' on dedicated pool dp-titan-02 (region: us-west-2). Spike started ~1918765400. Dashboard: https://console.internal/incidents/1918765432
ben (oncall): Got it — I'm taking the pager. beginning triage now.
alice (sre): Checking host metrics. GPU util on node group dp-titan-02 is 98%, queue length up x6, tail latency > 2s. I see a small set of pods with repeated OOMs.
devon (eng-runtime): Looking at request traces — many identical long requests causing KV cache churn and huge KV miss penalty. Likely noisy-tenant amplification under batching.
ben (oncall): Paging escalation -> paging eng-runtime and cs. @carla can you ping Titan?
carla (cs): Reached out to Titan support contact (sarah@titan.co). They're seeing increased errors on their side and have traffic throttled client-side. They've requested updates every 15m.
alice (sre): Immediate mitigation suggestions: 1) isolate Titan traffic to its own queue (disable cross-tenant batching), 2) temporarily restrict max_concurrent_requests for tenant to 10, 3) spin up 2x burst nodes in dp-titan-02, 4) if saturation continues, failover a portion of traffic to dp-fallback-usw.
devon (eng-runtime): I can push a runtime flag to disable cross-tenant batching and deploy a per-tenant concurrency cap. Preparing a small patch now.
ben (oncall): Do it. Also start tenant isolation playbook (scripts/isolate-tenant.sh tenant=titan pool=dp-titan-02).
ops-bot: Action started: isolate-tenant.sh — job id 8712.
devon (eng-runtime): Patch deployed (rev: runtime@b3f9). Cross-tenant batching disabled for dp-titan-02. Concurrency cap applied: 10.
ops-bot: Burst nodes requested (2) in dp-titan-02, request id 9921. Autoscaler confirmed.
alice (sre): After isolation + burst, queue length dropped x3, error rate down by 60% in last 3m. Latency tail improving. Continuing observation.
carla (cs): Relayed mitigation to Titan: "we've isolated your traffic, applied a temporary concurrency cap, and added burst capacity. Monitoring now." They appreciated the quick update.
ben (oncall): Marking current state as: mitigated (degraded). Keeping P1 until fully stable.
incident-bot: Mitigation annotated: tenant isolation + concurrency cap + burst capacity applied. Current error rate -58% vs peak.
devon (eng-runtime): Root cause preliminary: a specific Titan workload pattern caused excessive KV cache evictions when combined with cross-tenant continuous batching; this created a positive feedback loop and local OOMs on worker pods. Need deeper replay to confirm.
alice (sre): Post-mitigation actions: collect heap/dmesg and kube logs from affected pods (exporting to /artifacts/incidents/1918765432), snapshot metrics, preserve config (runtime flags).
carla (cs): Customer requested an incident timeline and proposed credits. They want an exec-level note.
elaine (acct-exec): For Titan (enterprise contract), propose: 20% monthly service credit pro-rated for impacted window + SLA review. Will draft recommended language but need impact window and affected requests count.
ben (oncall): Recording impact window: start 1918765400, mitigated 1918765525. Will pull exact error counts.
devon (eng-runtime): I'll run a focused replay on a copy of the tenant workload to reproduce the KV eviction pattern. Assigning to me + alice. ETA for initial RCA notes: 48h.
alice (sre): I'll produce node-level timeline (1-2 pages) and attach logs.
carla (cs): I'll draft the customer-facing post-incident note (technical + what we did + next steps) and coordinate with Elaine for credits/exec summary.
elaine (acct-exec): Timeline for comms: internal exec brief in 24h, external customer summary in 36h, final RCA in 72h. Approving provisional credit proposal: 20% pro-rata for billing period + 1-month support credit.
ben (oncall): Action items:
- devon + alice: RCA draft (72h)
- carla: external customer note (36h)
- elaine: exec brief + credit calc (24h)
- ops-bot: preserve artifacts (done)
Please update this thread as you make progress.
ops-bot: Artifacts exported to s3://redwood-incidents/1918765432/*
carla (cs): Draft posted to drive: https://drive.internal/notes/1918765432/titan_customer_note.md — feedback welcome.
devon (eng-runtime): Quick note: long-term mitigation options: per-tenant KV admission control, smarter batch scheduling to avoid cross-tenant amplification, and tenant-specific memory reservations on dp pools. I'll include options in the RCA.
alice (sre): Suggest we add a short-term rule to default-disable cross-tenant batching on dedicated pools handling enterprise tenants until we validate scheduling changes.
elaine (acct-exec): I'll include the credit calculation and suggested customer exec email in the briefing.
ben (oncall): Thanks team. Marking incident as "mitigated - in postmortem". Will handoff to RCA owners.
incident-bot: Incident P1 status changed: mitigated -> postmortem. Owners: devon (eng-runtime), alice (sre), carla (cs), elaine (acct-exec).
carla (cs): Closing loop with Titan now — sending the drafted note and scheduling a 30m sync with their engineering lead at 1918766200.
ben (oncall): Leaving a final note for responders: good job on rapid isolation. Keep follow-ups in this thread. :thumbsup:
